nodes.summary: For a real polynomial $p$ with Sturm chain $p_0, p_1, \dots, p_m$ and a real number $x$, $\sigma_p(x)$ is the number of sign changes, ignoring zeros, in the sequence of values $p_0(x), p_1(x), \dots, p_m(x)$.
nodes.title: Sturm sign-variation function

nodes.summary: For a list $x_1, \dots, x_n$ of real numbers, let $y_1, \dots, y_m$ be the entries of the list that are nonzero, in their original order. The number of sign changes of the list is the number of indices $i$ with $1 \le i < m$ and $y_i y_{i+1} < 0$, that is, the number of adjacent pairs of opposite sign once the zeros are removed.
nodes.title: Number of sign changes in a list of reals

nodes.summary: For real polynomials $a$, $b$ and a natural number $n$, this is the list of polynomials defined recursively by: for $n = 0$ it is the one-entry list $(a)$; for fuel $n + 1$ it is $(a)$ if $b = 0$, and otherwise it is $a$ followed by the list for the pair $b$, $-(a \bmod b)$ with fuel $n$, where $a \bmod b$ is the remainder of $a$ on division by $b$.
nodes.title: Negated-remainder sequence with fuel

nodes.summary: The Sturm chain of a real polynomial $p$ is the list $p_0, p_1, \dots, p_m$ with $p_0 = p$, $p_1 = p'$ and $p_{k+1} = -(p_{k-1} \bmod p_k)$, the negated remainder of $p_{k-1}$ on division by $p_k$, where the list stops at $p_m$ as soon as the next entry would be $0$; thus $p_m$ is its last entry and, for $p \ne 0$, every entry is nonzero. For $p = 0$ the chain is the one-entry list $(0)$.
nodes.title: Sturm chain

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a squarefree real polynomial and let $a < b$ be real numbers with $p(a) \ne 0$ and $p(b) \ne 0$. Then the number of distinct real roots $x$ of $p$ with $a < x < b$ equals $\sigma_p(a) - \sigma_p(b)$, where $\sigma_p$ is the Sturm sign-variation function of $p$ and the subtraction is truncated subtraction of natural numbers.
nodes.title: Sturm's theorem

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
